name: Blanchy
summary: Near the Jansen Stead, Blanchy rests beside the Furlbrows’ wagon in Westfall. The gentle mare travels through the troubled countryside with Theodore and Verna Furlbrow.

sections.title: A Faithful Farmhand
sections.body: Before Blanchy drew the Furlbrows’ wagon through Westfall, she worked their farm in Stormwind’s breadbasket. She was sweet-tempered and known for behaving well. Years of hard labor have worn her down, and the journey away from troubled homesteads has left her exhausted. Yet her appetite remains hearty. Verna offers Blanchy’s treasured blanket and feed pouch to travelers who bring nourishing handfuls of oats from nearby fields.

faq.answer: Theodore and Verna Furlbrow own Blanchy, and they travel through Westfall. She is their draft horse and beloved companion.

faq.q: Where did Blanchy originally come from?
faq.answer: No record tells where Blanchy was foaled. As far as anyone in Westfall knows, she has long belonged to the Furlbrows and worked their farm until the family had to take to the road.

faq.q: Why does Verna Furlbrow need oats for Blanchy?
faq.answer: Years of labor and the long journey along Westfall’s dangerous roads have drained Old Blanchy. Verna asks travelers to gather the remaining bags of oats from nearby farmlands to restore the horse’s strength.
Old Blanchy stands hitched beside the Furlbrow wagon along the main road near the Jansen Stead in northern Westfall.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler heading south from Elwynn Forest into Westfall, you may help feed Old Blanchy among your first acts of kindness for the struggling local refugees.
